title: Interrupted spring updates
intent: Compare tweens and physical springs while keyed data is reordered, inserted, removed, and interrupted.

ai.create: Create a keyed composed bar and line chart that can compare tweens with physical springs and can accept a second target while the first transition is still running.
ai.maintain: Preserve stable datum keys, enter/update/exit phase semantics, value and velocity continuity during interrupted springs, rest-based settling, presentation-aware pointer resolution, and the direct @tanstack/charts/motion renderer boundary.
